title: A school coursework platform whose parts state different access checks
provenance: Synthetic system authored for this corpus (issue #2054, phase 2). Not derived from, or sanitized from, any real system: there is nothing to leak by omission.
notes: The case exists for issue #2054. It measures the assertion pass on the authorization-scope predicates. The source states each part on its own element: the coursework service checks each request against the user's role (each request yes) and does not check that a submission belongs to the student (ownership no), its database account is limited to the coursework tables (least privilege yes), the admin console does not check that a teacher is an administrator (each request no), and the grade export's read-only access is a hedge that must stay unknown. The tampering and the information-disclosure must-finds rest on the missing ownership check. The elevation-of-privilege must-find rests on the admin console's missing check across the office network, a privilege zone. The domain is a school, which no other case covers.
